items.name: Ekadashi Vrat
items.food_rule: No grains, fruits/milk allowed, no food after sunset
items.best_day: 11th day of lunar fortnight (both Shukla and Krishna Paksha)
benefits: Attainment of Moksha and liberation from the cycle of birth and death
Prosperity and abundance in all areas of life
Deep devotion and connection with Lord Vishnu
Complete removal of all sins and negative karma
Removal of all obstacles and challenges
Attainment of all desires and wishes
items.story: Once a demon named Mura was killed by Vishnu on this day, and the goddess Ekadashi emerged from Vishnu's body. Observing Ekadashi Vrat is believed to grant liberation and remove all sins. The story goes that King Ambarisha observed Ekadashi Vrat with great devotion and was protected by Vishnu from the wrath of Sage Durvasa.
items.procedure: Begin the fast at sunrise on Ekadashi day. Avoid all grains, beans, and their products. Eat only fruits, milk, and allowed foods like sabudana. Engage in Vishnu worship, chant Vishnu Sahasranama, and meditate. Break the fast at sunrise on the next day (Dwadashi).
items.ideal_for: All devotees, especially Vaishnavas and those seeking liberation

items.name: Pradosh Vrat
items.food_rule: Fruits and milk only, no grains
items.best_day: 13th day of lunar fortnight (both Shukla and Krishna Paksha)
benefits: Attainment of marital bliss and harmony
Deep devotion and connection with Lord Shiva
Complete removal of all sins and negative karma
Removal of all obstacles and challenges
Attainment of all desires and wishes
items.story: Devotees observe this vrat to please Lord Shiva during Pradosh Kaal, the period of 1.5 hours before and after sunset. It is believed that Shiva is most accessible during this time. The story goes that a devotee named Supriya observed Pradosh Vrat with great devotion and was blessed with wealth, prosperity, and liberation.
items.procedure: Begin the fast at sunset. Worship Lord Shiva during Pradosh Kaal. Perform Abhishekam of Shiva Linga with milk, water, and panchamrit. Chant the Shiva mantra and Rudram. Break the fast after the puja with fruits and milk.
items.ideal_for: Shiva devotees, those seeking marital bliss and health

items.name: Sankashti Chaturthi
items.food_rule: No food until moonrise, fruits/milk allowed after
benefits: Complete removal of all obstacles and challenges
Attainment of success in all endeavors
Deep devotion and connection with Lord Ganesha
Removal of all fears and anxieties
Attainment of all desires and wishes
items.story: Lord Ganesha removes all sankat (problems) of devotees who observe this vrat. The story goes that King Chandrashekhar observed Sankashti Chaturthi and was blessed with a son and prosperity. Ganesha is believed to be especially accessible on this day.
items.procedure: Begin the fast at sunrise. Worship Lord Ganesha throughout the day. Chant the Ganesha mantra 108 times. Break the fast after sighting the moon. End with a prayer to Ganesha.

items.name: Vinayaka Chaturthi
items.food_rule: Fruits and milk only, no grains
benefits: Deep devotion and connection with Lord Ganesha
items.story: Lord Ganesha blesses devotees with intellect and success on this day. The story goes that the gods worshipped Ganesha on this day and were blessed with success in their endeavors.
items.procedure: Begin the fast at sunrise. Worship Lord Ganesha throughout the day. Offer modak and durva grass. Chant the Ganesha mantra 108 times. Break the fast at sunset.
items.ideal_for: Ganesha devotees, those seeking wisdom and success

items.name: Purnima Vrat
benefits: Deep devotion and connection with Lord Vishnu
items.story: Full moon is auspicious for Vishnu worship and charity. It is believed that Vishnu himself resides in the full moon. The story goes that King Bharata observed Purnima Vrat and attained liberation.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Vishnu throughout the day. Perform charity and donations. Break the fast at sunset.
items.ideal_for: All devotees, those seeking prosperity and peace

items.name: Amavasya Vrat
items.food_rule: Fasting or light food, no grains
benefits: Peace and liberation for departed ancestors
Peace and harmony in the family
items.story: Ancestors are remembered and offered tarpan on this day. The story goes that the Pandavas observed Amavasya Vrat and were blessed with victory in the Mahabharata war.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Perform Tarpan (offering of water and sesame) to ancestors. Offer food and prayers to departed souls. Break the fast at sunset.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking ancestors blessings and removal of Pitru dosha

items.name: Somvar Vrat
items.food_rule: One meal or fruits only, no grains
benefits: Attainment of marital bliss and harmony
Deep devotion and connection with Lord Shiva
items.story: Parvati performed this vrat to get Shiva as her husband. The story goes that a princess named Parvati observed Somvar Vrat with great devotion and was blessed with Lord Shiva as her husband.
items.procedure: Eat only one meal on Monday (preferably in the evening). Drink water as needed. Worship Lord Shiva throughout the day. Chant the Shiva mantra 108 times.
items.ideal_for: Shiva devotees, those seeking marital bliss

items.name: Mangalvar Vrat
benefits: Powerful protection from all evil forces
items.story: Hanuman ji blesses devotees with strength and courage on this day. The story goes that a devotee named Anjana observed Mangalvar Vrat and was blessed with Hanuman as her son.
items.procedure: Eat only one meal on Tuesday (preferably without salt). Drink water as needed. Worship Lord Hanuman throughout the day. Chant the Hanuman mantra 108 times.
items.ideal_for: Hanuman devotees, those seeking strength and courage

items.name: Budhvar Vrat
items.story: Vishnu blesses devotees with intellect and business acumen. The story goes that a merchant named Dhanapala observed Budhvar Vrat and was blessed with immense wealth.
items.procedure: Eat only green vegetables on Wednesday (without salt). Drink water as needed. Worship Lord Vishnu throughout the day. Chant the Vishnu mantra 108 times.
items.ideal_for: Vishnu devotees, those seeking business success

items.name: Guruvar Vrat
items.story: Devotees worship Vishnu or Dattatreya for wisdom. The story goes that Sage Narada observed Guruvar Vrat and was blessed with divine knowledge.
items.procedure: Eat only yellow food on Thursday (without salt). Drink water as needed. Worship Vishnu or Dattatreya throughout the day.

items.name: Shukravar Vrat
items.story: Lakshmi ji blesses devotees with wealth and prosperity. The story goes that Goddess Lakshmi herself observed Shukravar Vrat to please Lord Vishnu.
items.procedure: Eat only white food on Friday (without salt). Drink water as needed. Worship Goddess Lakshmi throughout the day. Chant the Lakshmi mantra 108 times.

items.name: Shanivar Vrat
benefits: Removal of Shani dosha and afflictions
items.story: Shani dev is pleased and removes obstacles. The story goes that King Vikramaditya observed Shanivar Vrat and was blessed with protection from Shani's malefic effects.
items.procedure: Eat only black sesame and fruits on Saturday (without salt). Drink water as needed. Worship Lord Shani throughout the day. Donate black items to the poor.
items.ideal_for: Those facing Shani dosha or seeking protection

items.name: Ravivar Vrat
items.story: Surya dev grants health and removes diseases. The story goes that King Yudhishthira observed Ravivar Vrat and was blessed with victory and prosperity.
items.procedure: Eat only wheat, jaggery, and fruits on Sunday (without salt). Drink water as needed. Worship Lord Surya throughout the day. Offer water to the rising sun.
items.ideal_for: Surya devotees, those seeking health and fame

items.name: Karva Chauth Vrat
benefits: Long life and well-being of the husband
Attainment of marital bliss and harmony
Peace and harmony in the family
items.story: Queen Veeravati observed this vrat for her husband's long life. When her husband died after she broke the fast early, she prayed to Parvati and Shiva and brought him back to life. Since then, married women have observed Karva Chauth for their husband's long life.
items.procedure: Begin the fast before sunrise. Maintain complete abstention from food and water. Worship Goddess Parvati throughout the day. Break the fast after sighting the moon and seeing the husband's face.

items.name: Teej Vrat
benefits: Attainment of marital bliss and harmony
Peace and harmony in the family
items.story: Parvati performed severe penance to get Shiva as husband. The story goes that Parvati observed Teej Vrat with great devotion and was blessed with Lord Shiva as her husband.
items.procedure: Begin the fast before sunrise. Maintain complete abstention from food and water (or eat only fruits). Worship Goddess Parvati throughout the day. Break the fast at night after the puja.

items.name: Vat Savitri Vrat
benefits: Long life and well-being of the husband
Attainment of marital bliss and harmony
Peace and harmony in the family
items.story: Savitri brought her husband Satyavan back from Yamaraj. The story goes that Savitri, through her devotion and intelligence, convinced Yama to return her husband's life.
items.procedure: Begin the fast before sunrise. Maintain complete abstention from food and water. Worship the banyan tree (Vat) and Goddess Savitri. Break the fast after the puja.

items.name: Ahoi Ashtami Vrat
benefits: Peace and harmony in the family
items.story: A mother observed this vrat for her children's well-being. The story goes that a mother of seven sons observed Ahoi Ashtami Vrat and was blessed with protection for her children.
items.procedure: Begin the fast before sunrise. Maintain complete abstention from food and water. Worship Goddess Ahoi throughout the day. Break the fast after sighting the stars.

items.name: Chhath Puja Vrat
benefits: Peace and harmony in the family
items.story: Draupadi and Kunti observed this vrat for their family's well-being. The story goes that Draupadi observed Chhath Puja Vrat and was blessed with victory in the Mahabharata war.
items.procedure: Observe the fast for 4 days. Day 1: Nahay Khay (bath and eat). Day 2: Kharna (fast from sunrise to sunset). Day 3: Sandhya Arghya (evening offering to the sun). Day 4: Usha Arghya (morning offering to the sun).

items.name: Navratri Vrat
items.story: Durga fought Mahishasura for 9 days and nights. The story goes that the gods worshipped Durga for 9 days to defeat the demon Mahishasura.
items.procedure: Observe the fast for 9 days. Eat only allowed foods (fruits, milk, sabudana, kuttu, singhara). Worship Goddess Durga in her 9 forms. Break the fast on the 10th day with a feast.

items.name: Shivratri Vrat
benefits: Complete removal of all sins and negative karma
Deep devotion and connection with Lord Shiva
items.story: Shiva performed the Tandava dance on this night. The story goes that Shiva and Parvati were married on this day. It is also the day Shiva consumed the poison from the ocean of milk.
items.procedure: Begin the fast at sunrise. Eat only fruits and milk. Worship Lord Shiva throughout the night. Perform 4 pujas at different phases of the night. Break the fast at sunrise.

items.name: Janmashtami Vrat
items.story: Krishna was born at midnight in Mathura. The story goes that Devaki gave birth to Krishna in a prison cell, and Vasudeva carried him across the Yamuna to Gokul.
items.procedure: Begin the fast before sunrise. Maintain complete abstention from food and water (or eat only fruits). Worship Lord Krishna throughout the day. Celebrate the midnight birth of Krishna. Break the fast at sunrise.

items.name: Rama Navami Vrat
items.story: Lord Rama was born in Ayodhya on this day. The story goes that King Dasharatha performed a yajna and was blessed with four sons, including Rama.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Rama throughout the day. End with Aarti and prayer for righteousness.

items.name: Hanuman Jayanti Vrat
benefits: Powerful protection from all evil forces
items.story: Hanuman ji was born to Anjani and Kesari. The story goes that Anjani prayed to Shiva and was blessed with Hanuman as her son.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Hanuman throughout the day. End with Aarti and prayer for strength.

items.name: Ganesh Chaturthi Vrat
benefits: Attainment of success in all endeavors
Powerful protection from all negative forces
items.story: Ganesha was created by Parvati from turmeric paste. The story goes that Parvati created Ganesha to guard her bath, and Shiva accidentally beheaded him, later replacing his head with an elephant's head.
items.procedure: Observe the fast for 10 days. Eat only fruits, milk, and Satvik food. Worship Lord Ganesha throughout the festival. Perform Visarjan on the 10th day.

items.name: Ratha Saptami Vrat
items.story: Surya dev started his northward journey on this day. The story goes that Bhishma Pitamah left his body on this day, choosing the time of his death.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Surya throughout the day. Offer water to the rising sun.

items.name: Basant Panchami Vrat
benefits: Attainment of profound knowledge and wisdom
Development of artistic talents and creativity
items.story: Saraswati ji is worshipped for knowledge and arts. The story goes that the gods worshipped Saraswati on this day and were blessed with wisdom.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food (especially yellow food). Worship Goddess Saraswati. Place books and pens before the goddess.

items.name: Maha Shivratri Vrat
benefits: Complete removal of all sins and negative karma
Deep devotion and connection with Lord Shiva
items.story: Shiva performed the Tandava and married Parvati on this night. The story goes that Shiva consumed the poison from the ocean of milk on this day, saving the universe.
items.procedure: Begin the fast before sunrise. Maintain complete abstention from food and water. Worship Lord Shiva throughout the night. Perform 4 pujas at different phases of the night. Break the fast at sunrise.

items.name: Holi Vrat
items.story: Prahlad was saved from Holika by Vishnu. The story goes that Hiranyakashipu's sister Holika tried to burn Prahlad but was herself burned, while Prahlad was protected by Vishnu.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Celebrate Holi with colors and joy. Offer prayers to Krishna. Break the fast with a feast.

items.name: Raksha Bandhan Vrat
items.story: Draupadi tied a strip of cloth on Krishna's finger. The story goes that when Krishna cut his finger, Draupadi tore a strip from her sari and bandaged it, and in return Krishna protected her during the vastraharan.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Sisters tie Rakhi on brothers' wrists. Exchange sweets and prayers.

items.name: Guru Purnima Vrat
items.story: Ved Vyasa was born on this day. The story goes that Vyasa, the author of the Mahabharata and the Puranas, was born on this day, and is worshipped as the Adi Guru.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship the Guru. Offer prayers to teachers and mentors.

items.name: Nag Panchami Vrat
items.story: Serpents are worshipped for protection. The story goes that the Naga Devatas bless devotees who worship them on this day.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food (no fried items). Worship serpent gods. Offer milk to snake idols.

items.name: Rishi Panchami Vrat
benefits: Removal of menstrual sins and impurities
items.story: Women observe this vrat for purity and blessings. The story goes that the Saptarishi bless women who observe this vrat with purity and prosperity.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food (no grains). Worship the Seven Sages. Offer prayers for purity.

items.name: Radha Ashtami Vrat
items.story: Radha ji was born in Barsana. The story goes that Radha, the consort of Krishna, was born on this day and is worshipped for love and devotion.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Goddess Radha throughout the day. End with Aarti and prayer.

items.name: Parashurama Jayanti Vrat
items.story: Parashurama, the 6th avatar of Vishnu, was born on this day. The story goes that Parashurama was born to destroy evil kings and establish righteousness.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Parashurama throughout the day. End with Aarti and prayer.

items.name: Vamana Jayanti Vrat
items.story: Vamana, the 5th avatar of Vishnu, was born on this day. The story goes that Vamana subdued King Bali and restored the balance of the universe.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Vamana throughout the day.

items.name: Varaha Jayanti Vrat
items.story: Varaha, the 3rd avatar of Vishnu, rescued Earth on this day. The story goes that Varaha lifted the Earth from the cosmic ocean with his tusks.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Varaha throughout the day.

items.name: Kurma Jayanti Vrat
items.story: Kurma, the 2nd avatar of Vishnu, supported Mount Mandara during the churning of the ocean. The story goes that the gods and demons churned the ocean with Mount Mandara, and Kurma provided support.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Kurma throughout the day.

items.name: Matsya Jayanti Vrat
items.story: Matsya, the 1st avatar of Vishnu, saved the Vedas from flood. The story goes that Matsya guided Manu's boat through the cosmic flood and saved the sacred knowledge.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Matsya throughout the day.

items.name: Narasimha Jayanti Vrat
benefits: Removal of all fears and anxieties
Attainment of victory in all endeavors
items.story: Narasimha killed Hiranyakashipu to save Prahlad. The story goes that Narasimha emerged from a pillar to protect his devotee Prahlad and destroy the demon Hiranyakashipu.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Narasimha throughout the day.

items.name: Kalki Jayanti Vrat
benefits: Destruction of all evil and negativity
items.story: Kalki, the 10th avatar of Vishnu, will appear at the end of Kali Yuga. The story goes that Kalki will appear on a white horse to destroy evil and restore dharma.
items.procedure: Observe the fast from sunrise to sunset. Eat only Satvik food. Worship Lord Kalki throughout the day.
